words.definition: vt. 承受；顶住，经受住

examples.en: The new stadium is designed to withstand earthquakes of magnitude eight.
examples.zh: 新体育场的设计能抗八级地震。

examples.en: Few small firms can withstand such fierce global competition.
examples.zh: 很少有小型企业能经受住如此激烈的全球竞争。

words.usage: 及物动词，过去式、过去分词 withstood，多接压力、考验、地震：withstand pressure 顶住压力；withstand the test of time 经受时间考验。with- 此处义为对抗。

confusables.note: v. 撤回；with- 同首
vt. 保留；扣留

collocations: withstand pressure 顶住压力
withstand an earthquake 抗震
withstand the test of time 经受时间考验
words.mnemonic: with(对抗)+stand(站)→ 迎着压力站着 → 承受住

words.definition: adj. 傲慢的，自大的

examples.en: His arrogant refusal to take advice led to the project's failure.
examples.zh: 他傲慢地拒绝听取建议，导致了项目的失败。

examples.en: The arrogant young executive looked down on his junior colleagues.
examples.zh: 那位傲慢的年轻主管瞧不起资历较浅的同事。

words.usage: 贬义形容词：be arrogant about sth 对某事自大；It is arrogant of sb to do sth 做某事实在傲慢。派生：arrogance n. 傲慢。

confusables.note: adj. 无知的；尾三字母同
adj. 优雅的；-ant 同尾

collocations: an arrogant attitude 傲慢的态度
an arrogant remark 傲慢的言论
be arrogant towards sb 对某人傲慢
words.mnemonic: ar(一再)+rog(要求)+ant → 一再强求 → 傲慢自大

words.definition: vt. 擦，揩；抹去 n. 擦拭

examples.en: She wiped the dust off the shelf with an old rag.
examples.zh: 她用旧抹布擦去架子上的灰尘。

examples.en: A single scandal could wipe out years of hard-won reputation.
examples.zh: 一桩丑闻就可能毁掉多年辛苦赢得的声誉。

words.usage: 及物动词：wipe the table 擦桌子；wipe sth off/from sth 从某处擦掉；wipe out 消灭、彻底摧毁。名词湿巾 wet wipes。

confusables.note: vt. 鞭打；多一字母 h
n. 金属丝；p 换 r

collocations: wipe out 消灭；擦净
wipe off 擦掉
wipe the table 擦桌子
words.mnemonic: 谐音「外泼」→ 脏东西向外泼走 → 擦、抹去

words.definition: adj. 显眼的；惹人注目的

examples.en: Safety instructions should be posted in a conspicuous place.
examples.zh: 安全须知应张贴在显眼处。

examples.en: He was conspicuous for his silence at the heated debate.
examples.zh: 在激烈的辩论中，他的沉默格外引人注目。

words.usage: 形容词显眼的：a conspicuous position 显眼位置；术语 conspicuous consumption 炫耀性消费；conspicuous by one's absence 因缺席而显眼。

confusables.note: adj. 尽责的；拼写高度相似
adj. 怀疑的；-icious 同尾

collocations: a conspicuous position 显眼位置
conspicuous consumption 炫耀性消费
conspicuous by one's absence 因缺席而显眼
words.mnemonic: con+spic(看，如 spectator)+uous → 众目所视 → 显眼的

words.definition: n. 烈性酒；酒

examples.en: The state forbids selling liquor to anyone under twenty-one.
examples.zh: 该州禁止向二十一岁以下者出售烈酒。

examples.en: He gave up hard liquor on his doctor's advice.
examples.zh: 他听从医生的建议戒了烈性酒。

words.usage: 美式专指威士忌、伏特加等蒸馏烈酒，英式泛指酒类：hard liquor 烈酒；liquor store 酒专卖店。与 liquid 液体同根，注意拼写中 -uor 的字母顺序。

confusables.note: n. 液体；同根近形
n. 利口酒；法语借形极近

collocations: liquor store 酒类专卖店
hard liquor 烈性酒
under the influence of liquor 酒后
words.mnemonic: 谐音「立刻」→ 一口烈酒立刻上头 → 烈性酒（与 liquid 同根）

words.definition: n. 传教士 adj. 传教的

examples.en: The missionary founded the first hospital in the mountain region.
examples.zh: 那位传教士在山区创建了第一家医院。

examples.en: She attacked social injustice with missionary zeal.
examples.zh: 她以传教士般的热忱抨击社会不公。

words.usage: 名词传教士，形容词传教的：missionary work 传教工作；引申 a missionary zeal 传教士般的热情。派生：mission n. 使命，使团；复数 missionaries。

confusables.note: n. 导弹；miss- 同首
n. 委员会；佣金

collocations: missionary work 传教工作
missionary zeal 传教士般的热忱
a Catholic missionary 天主教传教士
words.mnemonic: mission(使命)+ary(表人)→ 身负使命远行的人 → 传教士

words.definition: n. 女巫；巫婆

examples.en: Legends say a witch once lived in the tower at the village entrance.
examples.zh: 传说村口的塔里曾住着一个女巫。

examples.en: Centuries ago, women accused of being witches were burned at the stake.
examples.zh: 几个世纪前，被指为女巫的妇女被处以火刑。

words.usage: 名词女巫，与男巫 wizard 相对；引申习语 witch hunt 政治迫害。派生：witchcraft n. 巫术；witch doctor 巫医。与 which 同音不同义，注意听写区分。

confusables.note: pron. 哪个；与本词完全同音
v. 观看 n. 手表；-tch 同尾

collocations: witch hunt 政治迫害
a witch's spell 女巫的咒语
accuse sb of witchcraft 指控某人施巫术
words.mnemonic: 与 which 同音 → 「哪个是女巫？」→ witch 女巫

words.definition: adj. 认真的，尽责的

examples.en: The conscientious nurse checked the patients' records every two hours.
examples.zh: 尽责的护士每两小时核查一次病人的记录。

examples.en: Conscientious preparation, rather than talent, won him the scholarship.
examples.zh: 为他赢得奖学金的是认真的准备，而非天赋。

words.usage: 褒义形容词，形容尽责的态度：a conscientious student 认真的学生。派生：conscientiousness n. 尽责；源自 conscience n. 良心。注意与 conscious 区分。

confusables.note: adj. 有意识的；去 cient 尾
adj. 显眼的；-cious 同尾

collocations: a conscientious worker 尽责的员工
conscientious objector 良心拒服兵役者
a conscientious attitude 认真的态度
words.mnemonic: con+scient(良心，conscience)+ious → 凭良心做事 → 尽责的

words.definition: n. 殖民地；聚居群，群落

examples.en: The country was once a colony of the Spanish empire.
examples.zh: 这个国家曾是西班牙帝国的殖民地。

examples.en: A colony of seals basked on the rocks at low tide.
examples.zh: 退潮时，一群海豹趴在礁石上晒太阳。

words.usage: 可数名词双义：殖民地（a British colony）与生物群落（a colony of ants 蚁群）。派生：colonial adj. 殖民的；colonize vt. 开拓殖民地。

confusables.note: n. 上校；形近音异
n. 古龙水；尾三字母异

collocations: a British colony 英国殖民地
a colony of ants 蚁群
penal colony 流放殖民地
words.mnemonic: colo(耕种)+ny → 去耕种新土地的落脚处 → 殖民地

words.definition: vi. 停滞；不流动

examples.en: The economy stagnated for a decade because of political turmoil.
examples.zh: 由于政治动荡，经济停滞了十年。

examples.en: Real wages have stagnated while housing costs keep climbing.
examples.zh: 实际工资停滞不前，住房成本却不断攀升。

words.usage: 不及物动词，经济语境高频：the economy stagnates 经济停滞；wages stagnate 工资停滞。派生：stagnation n. 停滞；stagnant adj. 停滞的、不流动的。

confusables.note: v. 蹒跚；摇晃；形近义异
n. 舞台；阶段

collocations: the economy stagnates 经济停滞
stagnating wages 停滞的工资
stagnate for years 多年停滞
words.mnemonic: stagn(死水塘)+ate → 水成死塘 → 停滞、不流动

words.definition: n. 入口；进入；登场

examples.en: Crowds gathered at the entrance to the stadium three hours early.
examples.zh: 人群提前三小时聚集在体育场入口。

examples.en: The bride's entrance silenced the entire hall.
examples.zh: 新娘一登场，整个大厅安静下来。

words.usage: 名词读 ˈentrəns：入口（the entrance to the station 车站入口）、进入、登场（make one's entrance）。动词读 ɪnˈtræns，意为使入迷，注意异音异义。

confusables.note: n. 恍惚；动词义的本词根
n. 进入；同根近义

collocations: the entrance to the station 车站入口
entrance exam 入学考试
make one's entrance 登场亮相
words.mnemonic: entr(进入，enter)+ance → 入口；重音后移则「使入迷」

words.definition: adj. 连续的，连贯的

examples.en: The basketball team celebrated its tenth consecutive victory of the season.
examples.zh: 篮球队庆祝本赛季十连胜。

examples.en: It rained for six consecutive days, flooding the low-lying fields.
examples.zh: 连续下了六天雨，低洼田地被淹。

words.usage: 只作定语：five consecutive days 连续五天；consecutive numbers 连续数。辨析：中间可有短暂间隔仍算 consecutive，continuous 则须不间断。

confusables.note: adj. 行政的；-cutive 同尾
adj. 随后的；同 sequ 词根

collocations: five consecutive wins 五连胜
consecutive years 连年
in consecutive order 按连续顺序
words.mnemonic: con+secut(跟随，词根 sequ)+ive → 一个跟一个 → 连续的

words.definition: adj. 核的；核武器的；核心的

examples.en: The two powers agreed to reduce their nuclear arsenals by a third.
examples.zh: 两个大国同意将核武库削减三分之一。

examples.en: Nuclear power remains a controversial solution to the energy crisis.
examples.zh: 核电仍是解决能源危机的一种有争议的方案。

words.usage: 形容词：nuclear weapons 核武器；nuclear power 核电；nuclear family 核心家庭（社会学）。派生：nucleus n. 原子核，核心，复数 nuclei。

confusables.note: adj. 不清楚的；与本词同音
n. 原子核；核心；同根名词

collocations: nuclear weapons 核武器
nuclear power 核电
nuclear family 核心家庭
words.mnemonic: nucle(核，nucleus 原子核)+ar(形容词尾)→ 核的

words.definition: n. 马力（功率单位）；（口语）动力，力量

examples.en: The new engine delivers over 300 horsepower while consuming less fuel than earlier models.
examples.zh: 这款新发动机输出超过 300 马力，油耗却低于早期型号。

examples.en: Critics noted that the plan had intellectual horsepower but lacked political support.
examples.zh: 批评者指出，该计划虽具智识上的实力，却缺乏政治支持。

words.usage: 功率单位，不可数，缩写 hp；口语喻「强劲动力」。horse+power 名词复合构词，同类有 manpower、firepower。常见搭配 brake horsepower 制动马力。

confusables.note: 火力，同 -power 复合词，喻攻击力
嬉闹打斗，共用 horse-，非功率

synonyms.note: 泛指动力功率，通用；horsepower 专指引擎马力
扭矩，机械术语，指旋转力而非功率

collocations: 300-horsepower engine 三百马力的发动机
brake horsepower 制动马力
gross horsepower 总马力
words.mnemonic: horse(马)+power(力) → 马拉重物之力 → 马力；喻动力

words.definition: vi. 蹒跚，摇晃；vt. 使错开，使交错；使惊愕

examples.en: The witness staggered to his feet and gave a confused account of the accident.
examples.zh: 目击者摇摇晃晃地站起身，对事故的叙述含混不清。

examples.en: The airline staggered its departure times to reduce congestion during the holiday rush.
examples.zh: 航空公司错开了起飞时间，以缓解假日高峰期的拥堵。

words.usage: 不及物表「蹒跚」；及物表「使错开」：stagger working hours 错开班次；另义「使惊愕」。派生：staggering adj. 惊人的；staggered adj. 交错的。

confusables.note: 昂首阔步，神气十足；stagger 是踉跄
口吃结巴，双 m；别与蹒跚混

synonyms.note: 老幼般蹒跚，书面；stagger 多因负重或眩晕
绊了一下可恢复；stagger 持续摇晃

collocations: stagger to one's feet 摇晃着站起来
stagger working hours 错开上班时间
a staggering number 惊人的数目
words.mnemonic: 谐音「死跌个儿」→ 差点跌个跟头 → 踉跄；引申错开

words.definition: vt. 逮捕，拘留；阻止，遏制

examples.en: He was arrested after border officers found forged documents in his luggage.
examples.zh: 边检人员在其行李中发现伪造证件后，他随即被捕。

examples.en: Swift measures were taken to arrest the spread of the epidemic in rural areas.
examples.zh: 有关部门迅速采取措施，遏制疫情在农村地区的蔓延。

words.usage: arrest sb for sth 因某事逮捕；引申「遏制」，常接 spread、decline 等抽象名词；短语 under arrest 被捕。派生：arresting adj. 引人注目的。

confusables.note: 警觉的；a-l-e-r-t，词形词义都别串
资产，优点；双 s 无 r，注意拼写

synonyms.note: 捕获抓获，军事通缉色彩；arrest 强调依法拘押
拘留扣押，可短期；arrest 多涉罪名程序

collocations: be under arrest 被逮捕
arrest the spread of 遏制…的蔓延
cardiac arrest 心脏骤停
words.mnemonic: ar(加强)+rest(停留) → 强令停下 → 逮捕；引申遏制

words.definition: vt. 撒，洒；n. 少量，稀疏小雨

examples.en: She sprinkled a few drops of lemon juice over the grilled fish before serving it.
examples.zh: 上菜前她在烤鱼上洒了几滴柠檬汁。

examples.en: The lecture was sprinkled with technical terms that baffled most of the audience.
examples.zh: 讲演中散布着令大多数听众困惑的术语。

words.usage: 句型 sprinkle A on B 或 sprinkle B with A；被动 be sprinkled with 喻「点缀」。派生：sprinkler n. 洒水器；sprinkling n. 少量。

confusables.note: 闪耀，-ar-；sprinkle 才是洒
短跑冲刺，-int 结尾；洒是 -inkle

synonyms.note: 散开撒布，范围乱而广；sprinkle 量小而匀
泼溅，液体量大成片；sprinkle 细洒如雨

collocations: sprinkle water on the road 往路上洒水
be sprinkled with 点缀着…
a sprinkle of salt 一撮盐
words.mnemonic: spring(泉)+kle → 泉水细细洒落 → 撒，洒；少量

words.definition: n. 软管，水龙带；vt. 用软管冲洗

examples.en: Firefighters connected the hose to the hydrant and aimed the jet at the burning warehouse.
examples.zh: 消防员把水龙带接上消火栓，将水柱对准燃烧的仓库。

examples.en: Workers hosed down the loading dock to remove the oil leaked from the barrels.
examples.zh: 工人们用软管冲洗装卸台，清除外泄的油污。

words.usage: 可数名词，复数可仍作 hose；动词短语 hose down 用软管冲洗，宾语多为地板、车身、甲板。旧义「长筒袜」现代少用，阅读中多指软管；搭配 fire hose 消防水带。

confusables.note: 薄雾，z 收尾；hose 是水管
剂量，一服；d 开头，别串成软管

synonyms.note: 管子，硬质输气输水；hose 柔软可弯曲
泛指管状物，可软可硬；hose 专指软管

collocations: fire hose 消防水带
garden hose 花园浇灌软管
hose down the car 用水管冲洗汽车
words.mnemonic: 谐音「好湿」→ 水管一冲浑身湿透 → 软管；冲洗

words.definition: n. 钩，挂钩；vt. 钩住；（喻）吸引

examples.en: He hung his overcoat on the brass hook behind the office door.
examples.zh: 他把大衣挂在办公室门后的黄铜挂钩上。

examples.en: The author used a suspenseful opening to hook readers in the very first chapter.
examples.zh: 作者用悬念式的开头在第一章就牢牢吸引住读者。

words.usage: 动词喻「吸引」：hook readers 吸引读者；习语 off the hook 脱身、by hook or by crook 不择手段。派生：hooked adj. 上瘾的（get hooked on）。

confusables.note: 兜帽，车盖；oo+d 结尾，hook 是钩
鹰；-awk 与 -ook 元音不同

synonyms.note: 固定系牢，泛指各种扣紧；hook 特指钩挂
意外钩住绊住；hook 多指有意挂上

collocations: off the hook 摆脱困境
hook up the speakers 连接音箱
a coat hook 挂衣钩
words.mnemonic: 谐音「虎克」→ 虎克船长的铁钩手 → 钩子；钩住；吸引

words.definition: n. 喷雾（剂），飞沫；vt. 喷，喷射

examples.en: Farmers spray pesticide on the orchards to protect the fruit from insects.
examples.zh: 农民向果园喷洒农药，以保护果实免受虫害。

examples.en: Tourists standing too close to the railing were soaked by the spray of the waves.
examples.zh: 站得离栏杆太近的游客被海浪的飞沫浇了个透。

words.usage: 句型 spray A on B 或 spray B with A；名词指喷雾剂与浪花。派生：sprayer n. 喷雾器。程度对比：sprinkle 洒、splash 泼。

confusables.note: 祈祷；前面加 s 才成喷洒
走失的，迷途；str- 三辅音开头

synonyms.note: 少量洒落颗粒；spray 成雾状喷射
大量泼溅成片；spray 细密如雾

collocations: spray pesticides 喷洒农药
sea spray 海浪飞沫
hair spray 喷发胶
words.mnemonic: s+pray(祈祷) → 边喷农药边祈祷见效 → 喷洒；喷雾；飞沫
